about.title: The inventory, and the people who know what is in it.
text: Global Marine Power supports marine, offshore, power generation and railway industries. High quality and a large inventory of spares, technical service, faster response and quick delivery are the basic services we provide.

We are continually expanding and developing our warehouse to help our customers in a more efficient way. We fully understand the needs of our customers and the urgency that is so often required in getting their engine back in service.

We are a provider of comprehensive solutions for the refurbishment and maintenance of ship engines. With decades of experience, our team of skilled engineers and technicians is dedicated to seeing every project completed with precision and attention to detail, and our commitment to quality, safety and environmental responsibility is at the core of everything we do.

We take pride in a reputation for delivering reliable solutions that meet the needs of ship owners, operators and management companies, and we build long-term relationships based on trust, integrity and service.
